column3: She's in her room... Come in.
She just came for a normal visit... huh?
I was naive for believing that.
Since I was worried, I brought juice up to Kirino's room...
Kirino, I've brought some juice and snacks...
In there, an unimaginable development awaited me.
Heh, so that's how it is～
Just what is going on here...?!
You know, just now? I wormed out the truth about why you became Kanako's manager from Kirino.
Then Kirino self-imploded all by herself. I learned a lot♪
I-I said it's not like that!
Eh? Wasn't the top prize back then... some kind of Meruru figurine? Isn't that what you have now～? Was it a present from Ayase?
Kirino... You're really bad at lying.
Even though Kanako just wanted to probe into the incident of me becoming her manager.
My little sister dug her own grave by revealing her otaku interests instead.
Kehehe, just resign yourself to it. This news will definitely get out.
Ah, you're still here. Tch, go away already, useless bum.
...That girl. She's still holding onto her grudge from before.
I want to put a close to this situation somehow, but...
...I can't think of any good ideas...
...I said... do you think it's weird... if I was an otaku?
This damn brat, declaring that without even a moment of hesitation!!
Because, isn't that like, being the same as the disgusting otakus that come to my performance?
Huh? Why are you interjecting? Disgusting is disgusting. Is there a problem?
Or rather, you should have told me sooner. Then I could've gotten a good seat for you at my Summer Comiket performance.
Well, you like Meruru, don't you? Kanako looks kind of like Meruru after all. Meruru's nerdy fans get super happy when I come up on stage in cosplay.
Why are you... able to treat me normally? Just now... you said I was disgusting, didn't you!
Well, I thought that Kirino was looking at me with weird eyes lately. She was acting strangely clingy.
Now that I know why, I finally understand. It's really disgusting. If it was anyone but Kirino, I'd definitely sever all ties.
I placed my hand on Kanako's head, and roughly rubbed it.
Wha?! What are you doing all of sudden!
...You're pretty manly... even though you're a shorty.
What are you saying! Are you making fun of me?!
...From now on, please continue to take care of Kirino.
I might have... misunderstood her a little.
Oh, it's you... It's been a long time since you last called.
Are you going to ask me out for a date again?
...A while ago, when I gave you an order about the kiss thing.
W-What's with her? She's being unusually admirable.
...When she's being mature like this, she's kind of cute...
So then, here's the next order.
...I knew it was going to be something like that!
